sections.markdown:
## C2 — Restraint, steering and vehicle-dynamics confusables with knowledge-graph hints

FACT_ID: sec04-R01 | anchor: A54
Children aged 2 to 4 ride in a harnessed car seat, while from age 4 they move to a car or booster seat until the adult belt fits, so the harness stage and the booster stage meet at age 4. [A54]
Why it matters: group_hint child-restraints; prereq_hint sec04-F06; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec04-F07, sec04-F08.
Source: [A54 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec04-R02 | anchor: A54
Leaving the booster depends on belt fit and a height over 4 feet 9 inches, typically between ages 8 and 12, whereas the front-seat rule is a separate age line of under 13. [A54]
Why it matters: group_hint child-restraints; prereq_hint sec04-F08; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec04-F09, sec04-F10.
Source: [A54 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec04-R03 | anchor: A59
An Antilock Brake System lets drivers keep better steering control during emergency braking without shortening stopping distance, and the vehicle may shake slightly when it engages [A59].
Why it matters: group_hint braking; prereq_hint sec04-F15; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec04-F17.
Source: [A59 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec04-R04 | anchor: A56
Hand-to-hand steering never crosses the arms and never lets go of the wheel, so the arms stay out of the airbag area and corrections can be made instantly. [A56]
Why it matters: group_hint steering-methods; prereq_hint sec04-F11; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec04-F12, sec04-F13.
Source: [A56 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec04-R05 | anchor: FXP0057
One-hand steering with the hand at 12 is recommended only when backing, which differs from the 9 and 3 or 10 and 2 positions used for forward driving [FXP0057] [A58].
Why it matters: group_hint steering-methods; prereq_hint sec04-F11; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec04-F14, sec04-F12.
Source: [FXP0057 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec04-R06 | anchor: A61
Pitch shifts weight front to back, so acceleration loads the rear and hard braking loads the front, unlike roll, which shifts weight side to side in turns [A61] [A60].
Why it matters: group_hint vehicle-dynamics; prereq_hint sec04-F20; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec04-F21, sec04-F22, sec04-F23.
Source: [A61 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec04-R07 | anchor: A61
In a left turn the weight rolls onto the right, or outside, side of the vehicle, not onto the side you are turning toward. [A61]
Why it matters: group_hint vehicle-dynamics; prereq_hint sec04-R06; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec04-F22.
Source: [A61 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec04-R08 | anchor: A62
The side-mirror reference point is a forward check: with the stop line under the mirror, the front of the vehicle sits about 3 to 6 inches from the line. [A62]
Why it matters: group_hint reference-points; prereq_hint sec04-F24; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec04-F25, sec04-F26.
Source: [A62 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec04-R09 | anchor: A64
Other drivers' blind zones are handled by speeding up or slowing down until they can see you, and buses, motor homes and commercial vehicles have larger ones called no zones. [A64]
Why it matters: group_hint blind-zones; prereq_hint sec04-F27; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec04-F28, sec04-F30.
Source: [A64 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec04-R10 | anchor: A53
The headrest lines up with your ears, while the lap belt rests on the upper thighs and the cross strap on mid-shoulder, three separate fit checks. [A53]
Why it matters: group_hint seating-position; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec04-F04.
Source: [A53 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0053]
